name: Refactor store chat
description:
The conversation focused on refactoring the Vuex store by migrating chat-related logic from `project.js` to a dedicated `chats.js` module.
`chats.js` now manages the state for active chats, chat lists, and complex socket-driven events like AI code generation and subtask creation.
`project.js` was streamlined to handle project lifecycle, workspace apps, and repository branches while maintaining a bridge to chat via Kanban boards.
The migration included specific getters for project-linked chat URLs and logic to synchronize Kanban board updates when new chats are created.
This structural change improves codebase modularity by separating project management concerns from the individual interactive chat and AI features.

https://v3.vuex.vuejs.org/guide/modules.html

messages.content:
Migrate from project all methods related with chats  to chats.js.
In the project state use $storex.chats to access chat stuff
